snippet.title: Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/games/ghost-of-yotei/ 

The award winning epic returns. Become a different kind of warrior in this definitive edition of the standalone Ghost of Yōtei experience. 

Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition includes new downloadable in-game content - Echoes of Sekigahara*, a new story expansion and Most Wanted*, a combat survival mode. 

Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition is available now. 

*Available via patch v2.0 or later. Internet connection and account for PlayStation® required to download. 

#ps5 #ps5games #ghostofyotei 

Rated Mature
